comment: Hand-crafted gold examples — anchors for the GPT-4 phrasing generator and direct training material. Covers user (filters/favorites/cart), admin (stock/prices/analytics), quantity disambiguation, semantic generalization, conversational/negative. All seeds are CANONICAL (variant A names). Schema augmentation in generator.py renames tool/field names per variant.

examples._comment: Bug-1 negative anchors: explicit admin verbs (пополни/уменьши/обнови) MUST stay update_stock — anti-forgetting.
Bug-2 patches: «не дороже X» / «не больше X» = max_price filter (NOT admin discount). Critical — model confused these with update_prices.

examples.user: столы не меньше 10000 и не больше 50000

examples._comment: Bug-3 patches: «бесплатно» / «за 0» = max_price=0 user filter (NOT admin set_price=0). CRITICAL — model was setting prices to 0!
Bug-4 patches: «по N штук» в 3+ step plan — НЕ должно быть update_stock между add_to_favorites и add_to_cart. Anti-confusion.
